label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/insecure-randomness): alert-TP — the insecure randomness is used to generate a session ID/remember-me token which is stored in a cookie and later retrieved from the session, making it a security risk. Alert 2 (java/xss): alert-TP — the user-provided value from the cookie is directly concatenated into the HTML response without proper encoding, leading to XSS. Both alerts are exploitable on their respective paths, thus the case is labeled TP.
